howe_sound.label: Howe Sound
howe_sound.text: >Marine Forecast Issued 10:30 AM PDT 15 August 2026 Today Tonight and Sunday. Wind light becoming southerly inflow 5 to 15 knots near noon except southwesterly inflow 15 to 20 over northern sections. Wind becoming northerly outflow 10 to 15 near midnight then becoming southerly inflow 5 to 15 near noon Sunday except southwesterly inflow 15 to 20 over northern sections. Showers this afternoon and this evening with a risk of thunderstorms. Showers Sunday late in the day with a risk of thunderstorms.
